notes.title: Space logbook #06 | Demo out now go and play it!
notes.content:
Your delivery has arrived! The Underpacked! demo is now available on Steam🥳​🚀​


Crewmates, the wait is over!

We are broadcasting from the main cabin of Drunken Duck Co. to announce something we've been working for months with care, memes and too much caffeine.


The demo and trailer of Underpacked! are now available! [previewyoutube="Yqu8Kfay-nQ;full"][/previewyoutube]


We are very happy that our delivery crew has successfully handed off all the hard work. Now it’s your turn, crewmates, to deliver those packages successfully in Underpacked! 


What’s included in the demo?
Local co-op mode to make delivery with a friend and face the galactic gig economy together. 

Solo mode with our helpful bot, Jul.IA, who will assist you with delivering and maintaining the ship. Keep your boss happy with flawless work!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXekXX4-QMgCzUVdBQcni0P4v-cyeBQklXv4GoXf1wkNO_oVtoTgBl5uXU3ylRekofGWHmytaivifeEzD5GqMJquznRpWuC_e0H1YTp_guqstTOLKGJQbYBPCACYGV5wxWHOGkvdBA?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"]

4 exciting and challenging intergalactic levels!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeO2jshCWkfmhQBMv0Y1KvyoCX-7kT_mOpPKSzezasbK26rBvoNeyAIySX7eZJGQhdQ5ffrI4xn3Z83YKmiVnf84aafM578UKMOVgm4WF0d2NcUPwhrOsks6s7AogPlUQdtwREq0A?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"]
Get ready for Underpacked!
DEFEND

Space is dangerous… Thankfully, your boss added a turret to the ship!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdp4PKqFScTbfjx4yWvT1NoeCFmUfBdBloEvMd-5kGGxUsqpCAC_q_rpmslLBrccE9d-6Ioum2VXMHBhBhdf3OKbAXESXinYPI1jfD3q3Z01ug4M6ADTIA0Yl0RhJeQovm4hEQo?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"]

PREPARE 

Handle each order and customize the package based on your client’s. Remember the package is the most important thing.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeevOByOxgWBjUwigd7ted6FudVVtNtnHrjB-Ea1h_qcri2KHcZQ-W8_4gyNL0XRN42kl-_NPfsfxw1552446aQrS-lgkro4qQKiRycwX2AfwzoexmxkgOVuJgXkFpVvMYZVhZJGA?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"]

DELIVER

Shoot the package into the mailbox and make sure it arrives on time. With a bit of aim and luck, it won’t get lost in space!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcPNSgp2tguycZ1RoDCF4jy22-aTK4ekgIGTsjtEqudnMvbn21ZWBk_ZuFjXZjoQjXiW7VVqQMAaTXC7EnlbBFFmn80UiVaxm1c_tl-6wWrEcjOuWD_iN3bmwnOZFGxlAggwAtpGQ?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"]


Want to know more? Check out Underpacked! social media 🎥


On our social media you will find the full delivery process of Underpacked!



It’s in Spanish, but we’ve added subtitles in all the languages. Underpacked! is ready to reach every corner of the galaxy.



And just before you go, check a look to our previous logbooks:

Space logbook #00 | The Underpacked! lift off!

Space logbook #01 | Creating a game: A galaxy-sized task

Space logbook #02 | Designing the cosmos

Space logbook #03 | Don’t panic: You Are Not Alone

Space logbook #04 | The stars look very different today

Space logbook #05 | The entire universe is waiting on your delivery



Thank you, dear crewmate, for picking up this delivery! But this was just the first shipment, we’re heading back to work, and there are many surprise orders waiting to be delivered.


See you soon! (If the boss decides to pay us)

Thanks for being part of the crew

— The Drunken Duck Co. team

notes.title: Space logbook #05 | The entire universe is waiting on your delivery
notes.content:
Your Steam Underpacked! Demo delivery arrives on July 11! 📦🚀


The delivery crew at Drunken Duck Co. is ready to bring the demo to the entire universe. Make sure you’re ready to pick it up!



Our marketing team has a little surprise for you…


Here’s a sneak peek at what you’ll find in the demo 👀


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXefX19_oFWNbVpDCWys-5eb_uG-3Jn91Jf-IrerNCU9PvLCRgs8NWyakwOZ1Tis8iamuNiFNhzFeEYUzJAjnqaw2ZWAcC9V3goXZg7a0_ptMBOcxdSYaMbl25-lmHjCB_Wvj_i7fg?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcXPlZG8om7df0TOBUZHXoEVbNnCIGFqjlXhnQdTX2VpvEE_uKjBx8oUmVlYt1v8nljJUDnP8WE1PlqyhwVUlsnuGvZOUANyAQ512xQVwaiNi9WAUi8IVXso30Ec4rU_yp_OtQb?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"]



We’ve been working hard to deliver the best product at the highest quality, and in just one week, you’ll be able to get your hands on it.



Just in case you’re still hesitating, here are a few solid (and totally unbiased) reasons to download the Underpacked! demo:

Play alone with Jul.IA, the AI that never complains, never makes mistakes (according to her), and somehow always seems to have everything under control while you run around in panic.

Share the cabin in local co-op and see if your friendship survives a shift full of stress, enemies attacking the ship, and customers demanding deliveries at record speed (with a five-star review, of course).

Experience real galactic chaos: packages piling up, fuel running low, and decisions made faster than you can think them through.

Core mechanics: prepare the orders, defend the ship, and deliver the packages… or just launch them into space and hope someone finds them.


Want to know more about how we put this campaign together? Universal-scale marketing 📹 

[previewyoutube="hwPNr-M06AI;full"][/previewyoutube]


It's in Spanish, but we've added subtitles so no one misses how we tried to take this strategy to every corner of the universe (or at least gave it a shot).



And just before you go, check a look to our previous logbooks:

Space logbook #00 | The Underpacked! lift off!

Space logbook #01 | Creating a game: A galaxy-sized task

Space logbook #02 | Designing the cosmos

Space logbook #03 | Don’t panic: You Are Not Alone

Space logbook #04 | The stars look very different today



Thanks for sticking with us for another week.

See you in the next logbook… or in the marketing room, where Jul.IA already has a plan to sell us all.



-The Drunken Duck Co. team

notes.title: Space logbook #04 | The stars look very different today
notes.content:
Welcome back, dear employees, ¿are your helmets clean yet? 🧑‍🚀


Communications from Drunken Duck Co.'s space station are resuming, and we're thrilled to bring you a very special announcement!


Let’s take a look at the concept art for Underpacked! 🎨


Our most beloved spaceshift is about to lift off, and our best employees are taking care of every little detail, packing every package, making sure no customer will wait another day for their delivery. But first, shall we take a look at the beautiful concept art of our game?


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/cf9f14c3d7bc5da30b1b901242982aeeaffb1223.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/0f44f529ae9ccb27fc7bf9daf4d75210c22d529b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/f14087243caacb8746e254b6d0510ab1f2ce98be.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/35cc4a5addfc7d4ee34b62d09c036d1c8c249cdc.png"][/carousel]
Concept art sheet with lots and lots of cats, in preparation to choose our little protagonist, Pistachín.



Our art team took every chance they had to make the most adorable, most qualified, most chubby, and most clumsy astronaut-cat-deliverer the universe has ever seen.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/05e4ab4b72c1749cca9f4b706de800dca4998256.jpg"]

Once we chose our perfect Pistachín concept design, it was time to make him orange, the most normal orange cat of the galaxy, right?



Sometimes we look back and wonder to ourselves how Underpacked! would’ve been if our beloved Pistachín ended up being a dog, or a black cat instead. Yeah, don’t mind us, horrible thoughts to have, he is perfect, and we are so humble, yes, but what do you think? 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/d5e3baa8710fdbaf2e4251bc9fe32fd112146ad9.jpg"]Excellent 3D model if you ask me. Not a single thought behind those eyes.


Would you like to know more? Here you have our latest art devlog! 🎥

[previewyoutube="qpxrqlal5vw;full"][/previewyoutube]
We know, we know, the drawings are static, but everything looks nicer in motion. It’s in Spanish, too, but don’t hesitate to turn on subtitles, art knows no bounds.







And just before you go, check a look to our previous logbooks:

Space logbook #00 | The Underpacked! lift off!

Space logbook #01 | Creating a game: A galaxy-sized task

Space logbook #02 | Designing the cosmos

Space logbook #03 | Don’t panic: You Are Not Alone



So much art to admire, and so little time to make those deliveries… Well, time to get back to work, see you next company approved 5 nano-minutes mandatory break. 



Thanks for tuning in one more week!

— The Drunken Duck Co. team

notes.title: Space logbook #03 | Don’t panic: You Are Not Alone
notes.content:
Welcome back aboard the Underpacked! spaceship! 🚀


We’re back with another weekly transmission from the operations center at Drunken Duck Co.
This time, we want to talk about something crucial for any interstellar delivery shift:

Who’s sharing the ship with you?


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXedteV2HWpIHi1r96BEUh_t1rL2Rb4Gw1YCd0ZXg-zPO29qxe0odtkrL-2QA2BBJPZgPsbywxKyknXGBQ0Tp3EyGJFwgpZy1m3oyEzFCBV8KOGVbELSZ2yvjZP8aDSL1G-R-tuodA?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"]

In Underpacked! you can face interplanetary chaos in two main ways:


Local co-op mode
Play with a friend on the same device. Split up the tasks, cover each other, and coordinate your moves to survive a shift full of stress, enemy attacks, urgent deliveries, and impatient customers.


Solo mode with Jul.IA
Prefer to play alone? No problem!
Jul.IA, our integrated AI companion, will be right there with you: she automatically detects the ship’s needs, prioritizes tasks, and helps you keep everything running (mostly) smoothly.



And when you assign her a specific task, Jul.IA communicates using emoji speech bubbles to clearly show what she’s about to do: recharge a generator, prepare a package, defend the ship…

She doesn’t speak (yet), but she gets the message across just fine.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/69e288251a7827904a36d708b13cbe64f9b5aea3.png"]

And yes, Jul.IA is probably more organized than you.
She doesn’t judge (out loud), but she always knows what the ship needs before you do.


Curious to see how Jul.IA works and how the co-op system came to life?Check out our latest programming devlog! 📹[previewyoutube="Z5PcfvyuX8s;full"][/previewyoutube]
It’s in Spanish, but we’ve added subtitles so no one misses how Jul.IA learned to do (almost) everything without complaining.



Before we go, don’t forget to check out our previous logbooks:

Space logbook #00 | The Underpacked! lift off!

Space Logbook #01 | Creating a game: A galaxy-sized task

Space Logbook #02 | Designing the cosmos



Thanks for sticking with us for another week.
See you in the next logbook… or in the ammo bay, where Jul.IA just sent a suspiciously passive-aggressive emoji.



— The Drunken Duck Co. team

notes.title: Space logbook #02 | Designing the cosmos
notes.content:
Welcome back comrades, the signal is still strong!


A new space logbook is coming in hot from the central systems of Drunken Duck Co. This week, we’re diving into game design and, most importantly:


What do you actually do in Underpacked!? 🚀


In Underpacked! you step into the suit of an interplanetary delivery worker. Your mission? Deliver packages as fast as possible… while everything around you falls apart.



The core gameplay revolves around three key mechanics:


🔧 Get ready
Manage the generators, prep the orders, keep an eye on fuel levels... and try to make sure the ship doesn’t fall apart before your shift ends.

                                             [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/95f96f01c03b1776126698f328409f8de4913b4a.gif"] 

                                                           So much to do, so little pay.


🛡️ Defend yourself
Think this job is just about delivering peacefully? Think again. Fend off space threats with one hand and patch up hull breaches with the other.

                                                    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/b90cf9f52e3cd1b98cfa0e845a2003e954cc7c3b.gif"] 

                                                   It’s our sardines vs. their tentacles.


📦 Deliver!
Paint, load, and launch the packages from the turret straight into our beloved customers' mailboxes. Be quick, we promised same-day delivery.

    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/28904e231f3fa4186f7de98520ac34ee3b61582f.gif"] 

                                                            What’s in the boxes…?


Want to see more? Check out our design devlog! 📹 
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/QYhNkEDjTlg?si=FoNjUnz0C7fLK9XM"][/dynamiclink]It’s in Spanish, but we’ve added universal subtitles so no one misses out on how this chaos is coming together.



Before we go, don’t forget to check out our previous logbooks:

Space logbook #00 | The Underpacked! lift off!

Space Logbook #01 | Creating a game: A galaxy-sized task



See you in the next logbook… or at the generator, if someone plugs the main cable in wrong again.

Thanks for sticking with us for another week.



— The Drunken Duck Co. team

notes.title: Space logbook #01 | Creating a game: A galaxy-sized task
notes.content:
Welcome back aboard the Underpacked! spaceship!
 We’re still transmitting from the main cabin of Drunken Duck Co. to bring you a new space logbook. This time, with the kind of news that makes you drop the package.


We’re making a demo (and yes, it's coming soon)! 📀

That’s right, a playable version of Underpacked! is on its way, and it’s coming very soon. This will be your first time chance to experience life as an interplanetary delivery worker, either with your crew or our ever faithful AI: Jul.IA.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/05cf1d699d2c25f899cfe6c0c342142147a63783.png"]This is, for now, the splash art for the main menu screen of the demo.


How are we doing it? 🤔

Curious about how the project is going? We’re sharing the entire development process on our social media, from misplaced menus to boxes wedged into places they should definitely not be.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/4085b513379ecb42f727adc19b933feab0400b00.gif"]Just your average well organized and clean chaos.


Need proof? Here’s our first devlog video! 📹
 
[previewyoutube="gmUES4_SRtY;full"][/previewyoutube]
It’s in Spanish, but we’ve added universal subtitles so no one misses out on how this chaos is coming together.



And just before you clock out, dear employee, don’t forget to read our past news on Steam:

Space logbook #00 | The Underpacked! lift off!



Thanks for sticking with us and supporting this indie, absurd, and logistically questionable project.

See you soon in the demo,

— The Drunken Duck Co. team

notes.title: Space logbook #00 | The Underpacked! lift off!
notes.content:
Welcome to the organized chaos of Underpacked!

Today we officially open the communication channel between the crew at Drunken Duck co. and our logistics minded space players. This is the first entry in our space log, where we´ll share what we´re working on, who we are, and why there's a turret on a delivery ship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/90e22f50f2eca558161535b151308c270d51a771.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/eb8fceba1ff61f8e8a1a560a09481b93738ff5ca.png

Underpacked! is a third-person co-op game where you and your team (or your beloved AI, Jul.IA) become interplanetary delivery workers. Your mission: deliver packages at record speed, prevent the ship from exploding, and survive the workday without getting fired… or worse, receiving a bad review from a customer.

Inspired by games like Overcooked, Fueled up or Moving Out, our game blends frantic action, cooperation (or total chaos, depending on your partner), and a healthy dose of workplace satire, all wrapped in a cartoon aesthetic and dark humor.

Heads up: you can play it alone, in local co-op, or with our integrated AI.

Underpacked! is our first project, and we can't wait to share it with you. Check out the official teaser!

https://youtu.be/4GhKjKnLN2o
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/78ca305278e919d5f55890e3d0c2a112f327826e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638059/d1f442bca1a31689dd44cb646a2937da4d2e92f9.png
We´re Drunken Duck co., an indie studio born in Spain in 2024 fueled by beers, memes and a strong desire to make different kinds of games. What we lack in budget, we make up for with enthusiasm, laughter and a bit of self taught-talent. We´re not a big company, but we believe that well crafted humor, critique and chaos can create truly memorable experiences.

Thanks for hopping on board with us. See you out there in space (or in the break room if someone remembers to refill the coffee pot).

— The Drunken Duck Co. team
